title: Embedded coefficient form of the Stacks integral criterion
statement: For prime ell, finite intermediate E in PadicAlgCl ell, a generator pi of the maximal ideal of its embedded integers, and Noetherian X in universe u, an arbitrary complex K of internal continuous integral coefficient modules is constantModelBoundedConstructible if and only if its restriction along the canonical constant-to-continuous map is stacksConstructible. All definitions are the actual maps and predicates of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]. There is no coefficient-universe equality hypothesis.

proof.text: Construct the lifted finite-dimensional instance and use the proved integerRingSheafIso from IntegralCoefficientExtComparison. Compose its underlying monoid-object isomorphism with the existing pointComparison between the absolute-value and spectral-norm presentations. Let F be scalar restriction along its inverse after inverse image to X. Exact faithful scalar restriction preserves and reflects boundedness. The generic constantModel_comap_iff, together with the derived homology comparison isomorphism, preserves and reflects constant-model constructibility in every degree. This identifies bounded constant-model constructibility of K with that of F(K).

source.place: Displayed criterion: transport of the local completeness and first-residue predicates; Stacks Tag 09C1.

proof.text: Apply the pointwise iff of integral_models_stacks to F(K). The completeness-transport iff identifies its completeness conjunct; the residue-transport iff identifies the conjunction of constructible residue cohomology and finite Tor amplitude. Combine these iff statements with and_congr, reverse orientation, and compose with the preceding constructibility iff.

lean.statement:
theorem integralModelsEmbeddedStacksCriterion
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.1) X K ↔
        IntegralModelsEmbedded.stacksConstructible ℓ E π X
          ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K)
